dogecoin.text:
And this isn’t just for XRP.

The tools powering XRPFi also apply to Bitcoin, 

Dogecoin, and other non-smart contract assets.

Flare is creating a new class of DeFi—grounded in 

assets the market already trusts. ↴

This setup allows Flare to pull in:

Accurate price feeds every 1.8s

Events from Bitcoin, XRP Ledger, Dogecoin

Interoperability with 75+ chains (via LayerZero V2)

It’s a smart contract chain connected to everything.
